about: A recorded simulated follow flight in a 5 m mine drift: the subject walks east along the drift. Telemetry is the flight controller's own stream; batches are the detector's output with their arrival time and frame exposure on the same clock; truth is the simulator's vehicle-to-subject bearing and range.

columns.local_position: t_s, n, e, d, vn, ve
columns.batches: arrival t_s, exposure ms, frame id, [x, y, w, h, confidence, class, track id, lock state]
columns.truth: t_s, bearing to the subject (rad), range m
